driver_routines_schedule.name: driver_routines_schedule
driver_routines_schedule.value:
("driver_routines"."schedule_kind" = 'ONE_OFF' AND "driver_routines"."one_off_at" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("driver_routines"."schedule_kind" = 'WEEKLY' AND "driver_routines"."days_mask" BETWEEN 1 AND 127 AND "driver_routines"."local_time" ~ '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$')
